programme.title: Целое во фрагменте. Моление о чаше
programme.desc: В сопровождении учеников после пасхальной трапезы Спаситель направился в Гефсиманский сад. Иисус Христос, как всегда, откровенно беседовал со Своими учениками, наставлял их, но, приблизившись к саду, вдруг замолчал. Он часто приходил сюда, чтобы помолиться и поразмышлять, но никогда Его сердце так не скорбело, как в эту ночь, в предчувствии последних мучений. Здесь, в Гефсимании, Иисус вынес тот страшный гнет безмерной душевной муки, который исторг из Его уст невольный душераздирающий вопль: «Душа Моя скорбит смертельно». В программе представлены картины заподноевропейских художников на этот сюжет. Ведущий: Татьяна Лебедева, магистр богословия

programme.title: Что есть Евангелие? Кто такой предтеча?
programme.desc: Знаете ли вы, что у каждого человека есть своя «пустыня» – место, где он остаётся наедине с собой? И что именно там нас может ждать встреча, которая укажет путь к спасению? Почему Иоанн Креститель – не просто историческая фигура, а пример того, как сегодня каждый из нас может услышать Бога? Вы узнаете то, что поможет не пропустить самый важный момент в своей жизни. Ведущий: Юлия Уткина, Гость: Николай Кунцевич, священнослужитель

programme.title: Возрождение. Возрождение и Святой Дух
programme.desc: Возрождение – это обновление духовной жизни, оживление сил, разума и сердца, воскрешение от духовной смерти. Преобразование – это изменение привычек, обычаев, поведения. Без силы святого Духа все наши усилия в борьбе с грехом напрасны. Участие человека в возрождении заключается в его просьбе о руководстве Святым Духом нашей жизнью, в его смирении, в покаянии, в осознании своей греховности и желании изменить ситуацию. В результате возрождения человек начинает испытывать удовольствие в исполнении воли Бога, удовольствие от служения людям, от исследования Священного Писания. Произойдет изменение его привычек, обычаев, поведения Ведущий: Владимир Котов, священнослужитель

Главное для ребенка – внимание родителей. Счастье для ребенка – это мама и папа. Семья – главный фактор в гендерном воспитании детей, где папа является образцом мужского поведения, а мама – женского поведения. programme.title: Il était une fois la planète Terre - Saison 1
programme.desc: L'histoire de la vie sur Terre a été ponctuée d'une série d'extinctions dévastatrices. Ainsi, à maintes reprises, des cataclysmes naturels ont menacé d'anéantir la majorité des espèces. Pourtant, à chaque fois qu'elle semblait condamnée, la vie a trouvé un nouveau souffle pour repartir de plus belle via une nouvelle phase de renaissance. Cette série-documentaire est racontée par Lorànt Deutsch.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Reservoirs
programme.desc: One of the smallest dams in the Bergisches Land is the Panzertalsperre, with an area of just four-and-a-half football pitches. On the other hand, the Dhünntalsperre is the largest with the area of 660 football pitches. They all transform a stretch of flowing water into still and stagnant water. As a result, completely diverse ecosystems have developed there: where the dipper once dived for insect larvae, cormorants and gray herons now fish and swans and coots cavort. In recent summers, even greater challenges have emerged: the effects of climate change - from extreme drought to destructive floods. On a smaller scale, a rather industrious dam master is operating flood protection: The Beaver. However, the water masses of the Wupper tore away half of his majestic timber castle - and the four young beaver kids were not seen again afterwards. Have they survived the flood? Not everyone can cope with the constant change in the dams, but they still remain an important wonder of engineering for many: for us humans as well as for a number of animals. By combining water management, ecological requirements and tourism a worthwhile goal is possible: Because for the Bergisches Land, its dams are among the most valuable and popular infrastructures that the region has to offer.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Discover Poland
programme.desc: The world‘s best helicopter camera system - the Cineflex Camera - was used for this documentary and delivered fantastic images in HD quality, revealing the surprisingly diverse landscapes and fascinating towns of Poland from a bird‘s eye view of Poland‘s medieval towns, the modern silhouette of Warsaw, the untouched nature of the border regions between east and west, the coasts to the north and the mountain ranges of the south

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto the dangerous roads of Afghanistan's Hindu Kush Mountains, the infamous Moloto Road in South Africa, along the vertiginous slopes of the Bolivian Andes and other "roads of death" in India, Georgia and the Ivory Coast

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these car routes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured!

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of the Andes
programme.desc: The Andes are the biggest mountain range in the world. Peaks of up to 7000 metres in height, do not only offer an imposing view, but also influence the climate by being the drainage and meteorological divide.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland - Canada's Eastern Point
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: mareTV: Madeira - Portugal's sea of blossoms in the Atlantic Ocean
programme.desc: Flower magic in Madeira: The Flower Festival Festa da Flor is the most important event of the year for the people of the Atlantic island. With it they celebrate spring, which is climatically practically all year round here, their island and themselves. The coast formed by lava, centuries-old laurel forests and green steep slopes make Madeira unique. Those who start right at the front of the big parade of the flower festival in the capital Funchal, will have made it. For Isabel Borges this dream has come true. She opens this year's flower parade along the harbour promenade with her festive group. This accolade does not only mean fame and prestige, but also a lot of pressure. Are the self-designed dresses splendid enough? Will the 150 flower children learn the dance steps in time? Will the flowers on the float hold out in the heat? For Isabel, it is now a matter of nerves.

programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to produce wine. Protected by thousands of small depressions that act as water reservoirs, they grow vines on porous volcanic rock.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E12
programme.desc: Des journalistes d'un magazine sportif viennent sur la plage dans l'espoir d'y trouver une garde-côte susceptible de poser pour une ligne de maillots de bains. Un alligator attaque des baigneurs.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E13
programme.desc: Logan passe le plus clair de son temps libre à offrir ses services au ranch de Carmen Masters. Elle recueille depuis plusieurs années les vieux chevaux de la région. Jesse Lee Harris veut l'aider à réunir des fonds pour le ranch.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E14
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un as du déguisement s'échappe d'un hôpital psychiatrique pour se venger de Stephanie et Logan, les gardes de Malibu sont en alerte. Ils ne parviennent pas à l'arrêter, jusqu'à ce qu'il s'identifie à un ange.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E15
programme.desc: Stephanie sombre dans la déprime lorsqu'elle apprend qu'elle a un mélanome. Hulk Hogan, le célèbre champion de catch, débarque à Malibu pour remercier personnellement CJ de lui avoir sauvé la vie, lorsqu'un surfeur l'avait percuté et blessé à la tête.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E16
programme.desc: Mitch et Matt partent faire du parapente. Le premier a le vertige, mais a décidé d'accompagner son ami par curiosité. Stephanie n'est guère rassurée par cette perspective.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E17
programme.desc: Stephanie recrute des surveillants de plage à Malibu, pour participer à une régate au cours de laquelle ils devront se mesurer à l'équipe de Santa Bay. Les grands-parents de Joey surgissent et réclament la garde de leur petite-fille qu'ils ne connaissent

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E18
programme.desc: A la recherche de son père américain, une réfugiée vietnamienne tombe d'un ponton et, dès lors, souffre d'amnésie. Mitch et Caroline décident de prendre l'affaire en main.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E19
programme.desc: L'équipe se rend à Hawaii pour effectuer un échange avec les sauveteurs locaux. Leur séjour n'est pas de tout repos. Mitch et Matt participent à un concours de pêche en haute mer qui tourne mal.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E20
programme.desc: Mitch et Matt sont sauvés par les habitants d'une petite île. Ils séjournent dans un village où ils font la connaissance de Léa, une troublante jeune femme. Logan demande à Caroline de l'épouser.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E21
programme.desc: Kaye Morgan donne un cours de navigation à un groupe de jeunes.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E22
programme.desc: Stephanie entraîne Cody au sauvetage sous-marin. A cette occasion, elle découvre une vieille pièce espagnole que Cody fait estimer chez un antiquaire.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S7E1
programme.desc: Logan décide d’écrire et de réaliser un film d’inspiré des Dents de la Mer. Il utilise un requin anesthésié pour le rôle du grand méchant, mais les choses tournent mal lorsque le requin se réveille.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S7E2
programme.desc: Mitch fait partie du jury pour le concours de Miss Malibu Bikini. Il est talonné par deux candidates qui feraient n'importe quoi pour obtenir son suffrage. Cody, après une mission de sauvetage dangereuse, imagine le « Windjet », un nouveau bateau d’inter

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S7E3
programme.desc: CJ se lie d'amitié avec Max, un vagabond qui prétend être un ancien costumier d’Hollywood. Lorsque Max décède, elle apprend qu'il lui a légué quatre millions de dollars. Manny rejoint les sauveteurs de Malibu.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S7E4
programme.desc: Mitch est « acheté » pour 5 000 $ par une riche investisseuse à l’occasion d’une vente aux enchères sur la plage. Les choses se gâtent lorsqu’ils s’échouent tous les deux sur une plage. Cody rejoint une équipe de hockey sur rollers.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S7E5
programme.desc: La température devient insupportable à Malibu et les gens affluent sur la plage. Les choses se compliquent alors que les services secrets informent les sauveteurs débordés que le Président veut venir visiter la plage.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S7E6
programme.desc: Mitch engage le DJ Jenny McCarthy pour animer Beachblast, un tournoi télévisé, dans le but de lever des fonds pour ses Olympiades. Cody emménage chez CJ et Caroline après avoir été mis dehors.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S7E7
programme.desc: La mère de CJ, une ancienne meneuse de revue de Las Vegas, arrive à Los Angeles et demande à CJ de l’aider à se cacher de son ex-petit-ami gangster. Les évènements s’enchainent tandis que les deux femmes déjouent les plans des méchants.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E5
programme.desc: Irène, la mère de Mitch, vient rendre visite à son fis, comme chaque année. Toutefois, son comportement étrange perturbe le sauveteur.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E6
programme.desc: Afin d'entraîner sérieusement les nouvelles recrues féminines, Stephanie, CJ et Caroline emmènent le groupe de filles sur l'île de Catalina, où elles ne seront plus distraites par les «bleus» du sexe opposé.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E7
programme.desc: Hobie rencontre un garçon, Isaac, qui souffre de l'indifférence de son père. Pour attirer l'attention de ce dernier, l'adolescent met sa vie en danger en surfant dans une zone très risquée.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E8
programme.desc: Logan emprunte la voiture de Cody sans sa permission. Peu après, il est impliqué dans un accident de la circulation. Une femme enceinte est blessée.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E9
programme.desc: CJ est sur le point de quitter la plage lorsqu'elle aperçoit Matt au loin. Après plusieurs mois passés en France, il est enfin de retour à Malibu. Mitch l'envoie en mission avec Neely.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu S6E10
programme.desc: Logan trouve un bébé abandonné à proximité de sa tourelle de garde. Il est convaincu que cet enfant est le sien. Il le ramène chez lui et semble apprécier les joies de la paternité, au grand étonnement de ses collègues.

programme.title: 45 Minuten Thüringen
programme.desc: In einer Koproduktion der lokalen TV-Sender in Thüringen bringt Moderator Mike Langer Politik ganz nah an die Menschen. In jeder Folge trifft er auf Politikakteure oder -beobachter aus dem Freistaat Thüringen und beleuchtet nicht nur die politischen Themen der Region, sondern auch die Persönlichkeiten hinter den Entscheidungen.Was bewegt die Menschen, die über Thüringens Zukunft entscheiden? Welche Geschichten und Erfahrungen prägen ihre Arbeit? ?45 Minuten Thüringen? liefert unterhaltsame und tiefgründige Einblicke in den politischen Alltag und zeigt dabei mitunter auch eine andere Seite der Politik. Freuen Sie sich auf offene Gespräche, aktuelle Analysen und persönliche Anekdoten ? für alle, die Thüringen und seine Macher besser verstehen wollen.

programme.title: Beathaichean a’ Bocadaich
programme.desc: Tha Sophie a’ coimhead tron phrosbaig sheunta aice airson faicinn ciamar a bhios beathaichean a’ bocadaich. Tha i ag ionnsachadh mar a bhios diofar bheathaichean a’ gluasad agus cuide ri a caraidean, tha i a’ cruthachadh dannsa. An-diugh, danns coltach ri iasg agus goiriola! Sophie looks through her magic binoculars to find out how animals boogie. She learns how different animals dance and, along with her friends, creates a dance using animal movements. Join her and dance like a fish and a gorilla!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha ’ad uile trang a’ deànamh na rudan air a bheil iad math, ach Beag Chlangair a-mhàin - chan eil coltas ro thrang aireasan. Tha Beag air cuir roimhe rudeigin air a bheil e math a dhèanamh cuideachd. Everyone is busy doing what they’re good at except for Beag Chlangai, he doesn’t appear to be too busy. Beag has also decided he would like to try to do something he’s good at.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Seach g’eil a h-uile duine nan cadal, tha na slamain airson rùrachadh - is carson a rùraicheadh dithis nuair a dh’fhaodar rùrach le ceathrar! As everyone is asleep the Blobs want to explore and why venture with two, when you can explore…with four!

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Tha sinn a' cluinntinn an-diugh cho romansach ’s a tha na capaill-mhara – mar a bhios iad a' tuiteam ann an gaol agus mar bhios iad a' dannsa còmhla. We hear how romantic seahorses are – how they fall in love and dance together.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Mairi NicAonghais a’ leughadh Nansaidh Leòmach. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Jane O’Connor agus a dhealbhachadh le Robin Preiss Glasser. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Mairi MacInnes reads Nansaidh Leòmach by Jane O’Connor, illustrated by Robin Preiss Glasser and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Tha Lan na sgìthear saor-stoidhleach ach feumaidh e ròghnachadh an e cur-seachad proifeiseanta a th’ ann neo nach e. 'S e amas am bliadhna an co-fharpais nàiseanta a bhuannachadh. Lan is a free-style skier but he must decide if he wants it to be a professional pastime or not. His ambition this year is to win the national competition.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha trioblaid aig Angelina oir tha cion luchd-turais a' ciallachadh nach eil mòran a’ ceannach an càis aice. Tha i feumach air cuideachadh. ’S math g’ eil Belle is Sebastian deiseil is deònach. Angelina has a problem as a lack of tourists mean that there aren't many people buying her cheese. She needs help. It’s a good thing that Belle and Sebastian are ready and willing.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Nuair a lorgas an tuathanach gu bheil pìoban ag aoidion, tha e a' cur fios air a' Bhòrd Uisge. Ach fiùs am measg nan duilgheadasan a tha seo, tha an treud a' faicinn cothrom airson beagan fealla-dha! When the farmer discovers he's sprung a leak, he calls the water board to come and fix the problem. The bored flock are thrilled by the opportunity to have some watery fun. When the workmen clock off, the party begins!

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A’ Chùil. Sa phrògram seo tha i a’ dèanamh soidhne agus rudan eile a-mach à sreang airson an stiùidio aice a sgeadachadh. Choirstaidh is back with another programme from her studio A’ Chùil. She makes a sign, and other things, out of string to decorate her studio.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Latha mòr dha Mgr Mackle le Mèar a’ bhaile a’ tighinn airson seann chlach na sgoile a chomharrachadh. Tha Daisy agus Danny trang a’ feuchainn ris a h-uile càil a chur air dòigh ach chan eil Mrs Fullerton neo na faoileagan a' cuideachadh ghnothaichean. A big day for Mr Mackle with the mayor coming to celebrate the school's ancient stone. Daisy and Danny are busy making sure that everything is in place, but Mrs Fullerton and the seagulls aren’t helping matters.

programme.title: Fuine
programme.desc: Gregor samples a new take on custard creams. Griogar MacLeòid is eileanaich eile lem molaidhean son fuine bhlasta staigh agaibh pfhèin.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Calum Maclean is in Fort William visiting an unexpected industrial site.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Mhoireasdan, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. Actress-turned-interior designer, Erica Morrison, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers, she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: An t-Eilean/The Island
programme.desc: When Lady Mary Maclean is murdered on the Isle of Harris, newly qualified family liaison officer PC Kat Crichton is assigned to the case. A high-profile case like this is the career opportunity of a lifetime but for Kat, this is not just a job. A decade earlier, she got caught up in the twisted web of the Maclean family and was forced to flee the island. Ten years older, a resolute Kat now returns, determined to bring the killer to justice. Nuair a tha Lady Mary NicIllEathain air a murt sna Hearadh, tha an t-Oifigear Teaghlaich ùr, PC Kat Crichton, a’ tòiseachadh air a’ chùis. Cha ghabh cùis le ìomhaigh cho àrd ri seo a sheachnadh ach do Kat, chan e obair a-mhàin a tha seo. Deich bliadhna roimhe, chaidh a glacadh ann an lìon toinnte teaghlach MhicIllEathain agus b’ fheudar dhi an t-eilean fhàgail. Tha Kat a’ tilleadh, nas sine, dàna agus daingeann gum faigh ceartas làmh an uachdair air a’ mhurtair. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Tha an Dutch Baby annasach ach anabarrach blasta. Brunch sònraichte air nach dìochuimhnich thu a’ chiad ghreis. The unusual but extremely delicious Dutch baby is a special brunch that you won't forget in a hurry. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal gu ruige Gleann Nibheis. Tha e a’ dol a shreap sgeir air a bheil ‘Storm’. Tha ‘Storm’ air a fùcadh am meadhan Poll Dubh, fear dheth na h-àiteachan is ainmeil ann an saoghal sreap. Bithidh e mar fhiachaibh air na sgilean a dh’ionnsaich e thar nam bliadhnaichean a chuir gu feum agus cuideachadh fhaighinn bho dheagh charaid. Coinneach MacFhraing travels to Glen Nevis to take on a climb called ‘Storm’, a classic test piece nestled in the middle of Polldubh, one of Scotland’s premier rock-climbing destinations. To succeed, he’ll need to put years of practise to the test and enlist the help of a good friend. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Na Sgiobairean mu Dheireadh/The Last Captains
programme.desc: Tha sealg a’ ghiomaich a’ gluasad chun chladach, agus tha am mì-rian ga leantainn. Ròpaichean air an rocladh, droch nàdar a’ tighinn am bàrr, agus Steven a’ strì gus faighinn dhachaigh ann an tìde airson co-là-breith a mhic. The lobster chase moves inshore - and with it, the chaos. Tangles mount, tempers flare, and Steven races to escape the mess in time for his son’s birthday. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.desc: Los mosqueteros vuelven y deben rescatar a un general francés de una impenetrable prisión española.

programme.title: Los Mosqueteros: Emilia

programme.title: River City
programme.desc: Things take a terrifying turn when Tommy collapses after being diagnosed with concussion. A dejected Tyler is forced to contemplate his next moves with Harry, Amber’s attempts at a grand gesture to Angus are interrupted by Teddy, and Chris tells Bob who he thinks Scarlett’s tormentor is.

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: Gary McAllister made the game of football look easy. The proverbial classy midfield player who saw the full picture, and could affect it, in the crucial seconds before his opponent. Unprepared to succumb to a story that began with knock-backs, Gary wrote his own place in the history and folklore of every club he played for - a winner at Motherwell, champion at Leeds, immortal at Liverpool, and a Scotland captain of some repute. But there were lows to counter the highs, and Gary discusses these with searing honesty. However, he is not defined by the hard times, but rather the moments where his class and will to win elevated him to the very top of the game. With contributions from Steven Gerrard, Gordon Strachan and Ardal O’Hanlon, this is the story of one of the greatest Scotland players of his, or any, generation.

programme.title: The Trials That Shocked Scotland
programme.desc: Through testimony, interviews and archive footage, this series examines high-profile court cases that have shocked Scotland. This episode features a family’s 18-year fight for justice following the 1998 murder of Surjit Singh Chhokar in Overtown. There is also the 2015 trial of William Paterson at the High Court in Glasgow. Paterson stood accused of shooting to death a well-known gangland figure in a busy supermarket car park five years earlier.

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: In Greater Manchester, upcycling expert Jacqui Joseph explores the Altrincham recycling centre, hoping to discover unwanted items that can be revamped or revitalised and sold on for cash. She calls on lighting designer Duncan to restore a once-loved retro radio, and can newbie Tyler find a way to save an old sewing machine table?

programme.title: Great Japanese Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael’s bullet train takes him through the undersea Seikan tunnel to Hokkaido, the most northerly of Japan’s main islands and home to the indigenous Ainu people. He begins by exploring the southern city of Hakodate, one of the ports which was first to trade with the outside world. Visiting a family-run miso factory, he finds out how the staple Japanese ingredient is made using soybeans and a cultured mould known as koji. In the centre of the city, Michael visits the star-shaped Fort Goryokaku, the setting for a turning point in Japanese history. He discovers how the last remnants of the Tokugawa military forces were defeated in 1869 by the new Emperor Meiji’s army, ushering in a new modern era for Japan. Swapping the Shinkansen for a slower pace in a diesel train, Michael leaves the city to explore Hokkaido’s stunning volcanic landscape, travelling to Lake Toya in the Shikotsu-Toya National Park.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s railway journey through the islands of Sardinia and Corsica sees him leave Sardinia and arrive into Corsica, the most mountainous island in the Mediterranean. In Ajaccio, he delves into the early life of the island’s most famous son, Napoleon Bonaparte, discovering how Corsica’s unique approach to childhood shaped the future conqueror. At a bustling food market, Michael samples the island’s wild herbs. He is captivated by the haunting harmonies of polyphonic singing, a sound deeply woven into the island’s soul. He then boards the legendary Trinichellu, Corsica’s historic metre-gauge mountain railway, for a breathtaking journey through the island’s rugged interior. In the heart of the wilderness, Michael discovers how cutting-edge technology and drones are being used in the battle against devastating wildfires, a crucial innovation protecting Corsica and beyond.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Margie Cooper v Tim Medhurst, round three, as they hop over the English border to the green grass of Wales in their electric green fire engine. They head to the home of the famous Ladies of Llangollen and take some tasty treats to auction. But will their offerings go down well?

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Developers in Eye in Cambridgeshire and Hylton Castle near Sunderland rejig layouts in their two-bedroom houses to create an additional bedroom for each home, while developers in Ramsgate in Kent turn their three-bedroom house into a two-bedder in favour of a stunning large bathroom. But will their decisions make them money?

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: The market town of Leominster is the destination for today’s show. Guiding the teams around an antiques centre in the Herefordshire town are Kate Bliss and Philip Serrell, but which team will make the biggest profit or the smallest loss at auction? Meanwhile, presenter Eric Knowles visits Hereford Cathedral’s 17th-century library, where the books are kept under lock and key.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Mehreen Baig, Clare Balding, Jamie Laing and Mike Wozniak take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games reusable coffee mug, which is brand new for this series?

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and his sidekick Sarah Greene host this quiz show, where the contestants race on moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers stop them in their tracks. Five contestants battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races, where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: Celebrity players Nitin Ganatra, the Rev Kate Bottley and Alex Gray, aka Apollo from Gladiators, face another knowledge battle, led by Vernon Kay and aided by unreliable tour guide Paul Gorton. It's the halfway point, and the gloves are off for today’s destination, Falkirk.

programme.title: The Farmers' Country Showdown
programme.desc: Goat breeders Sam and Jess are excited to have a day away from their Sheffield smallholding and head to the Royal Cheshire County Show with their beloved goat herd in tow. A lot rides on today’s results, including whether their male goat Apollo becomes a champion winner this year. Meanwhile, goat farming couple Mark and Graeme from Catterick have been monitoring milk yields and ensuring their pedigree herd is in top condition for the competition. Devoted to his goats, Mark hopes a perfect performance will be rewarded with the very best rosettes.

programme.title: Spy in the Ocean
programme.desc: Spy creatures uncover surprising undersea relationships as sharks befriend fish, whales play with dolphins, and lobsters do the conga in seas where even spider crabs have friends.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: In the second visit to Sherborne School in Dorset, Michael Aspel and the experts find an original monk's bench, letters from Lewis Carroll and an 18th-century satinwood cabinet of great value, as well as a 'naughty' cigarette case and part of the airframe of the R100 airship.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The show comes from the RAF Museum at Hendon in London. Antiques experts Anita Manning and Mark Stacey find some real treasures among the bags and boxes to take to auction. There's a photo album of RAF Hendon in the 30s and a rare picture that brings a surprise in the saleroom. And Paul Martin visits an exhibition of First World War flying pioneers.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Chris Bisson, Danielle Harold, Katharine Merry and Robert Webb take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted by the House of Games retro bag?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - Wild Reckoning
programme.desc: Estranged brother and sister Dawn and David come face to face for the first time in nearly five years. Their relationship has always been complicated, with Dawn being given up for adoption at birth while her younger brother was kept. Dawn reconnected with the family in her teens but struggled to feel accepted. When she failed to attend their birth mother’s funeral, David broke off contact. The pair take on a navigation challenge and, the ultimate test of trust, a counterbalance abseil. They also confront painful subjects from their past in an emotional campfire chat with relationship therapist Simone. Will two days surviving in the wild be enough to heal the rift between them?

programme.title: European Athletics Championships
programme.desc: The men’s decathlon continues on day three of the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham with the high jump and the 400m. A new champion will also be crowned as the women’s hammer final gets underway. Gabby Logan is joined in the studio by Jessica Ennis-Hill, Jenny Meadows and Greg Rutherford, and they also reflect on all the action from the morning session. Commentary comes from Steve Cram, Steve Backley, Andrew Cotter, Colin Jackson and Paula Radcliffe.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team restores a photo of President Kennedy’s children with their English nanny, a tiny drum kit clock, a melted wax statuette and a traditional Venezuelan stringed instrument.

programme.title: Murder Trial
programme.desc: In 2024, the body of 65-year-old groundsman Brian Low is discovered on a country track in rural Aberfeldy, his beloved black labrador Millie by his side. Police assume that Brian has suffered a medical episode, but six days later, the post-mortem reveals the shocking truth - Brian has been shot dead. His former colleague and gamekeeper on the estate where he worked, David Campbell, now stands trial for his murder. With the site of the murder exposed to the elements for days, police are unable to forensically link anyone to the deceased. The prosecution builds a case against the accused around smaller, individual strands of circumstantial evidence while working to convince the jury that he is guilty beyond reasonable doubt.

programme.title: Inside No. 9
programme.desc: Shane and Clifford have a plan to abduct the wife of a wealthy hedge fund manager. If he won’t pay them the money, they’ll snip her ears off to prove they mean business. Everything in the plan depends on everyone playing their part right to the end. It’s totally foolproof - isn’t it?

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: How did the horse become so fast? Chris Packham sets out on a slithering, swimming, sprinting odyssey that explores the evolutionary beginnings of animal movement and how it reached its peak in one of the most elegant and athletic animals on earth: the horse.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Tempers flare as old beefs resurface at Char's new product launch. Nina and Phor work to put Phorever first, and Prince struggles with a choice offered and a choice made.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.sub-title: Welcome to the World of Being Seen
programme.desc: With more and more artists joining 9MAG, Ryan comes back as focused as ever on his growing shop. Charmaine cleans house at 2nd City and implements new restrictions that leave the crew at 9MAG wondering "What's going on with Charmaine?"

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Don and Phor worry that Ryan might see their growth outside of the shop as disloyalty. As Draya settles into 9MAG, she finds out you can't run from all of your problems. Shogun throws a party to welcome all the new artists.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When the electric company arrives and pulls the power because Cease hasn't paid the bill, the crew can't work and they are forced to close the shop. Recording artist Erica Mena stops by the shop to have Dutchess cover a tattoo. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew No Structure to the Madness
programme.desc: In the wake of Sassy's dramatic departure, Ceaser is left to wonder if the joke, and Dutchess' attitude, have gone too far. Alex uncovers some scandalous information about Dutchess online…information that could ruin her reputation. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew These are Minions!
programme.desc: With the Black Ink staff dwindling, Ceaser meets with a potential new (female) employee, who is quickly shot down by Dutchess. Puma checks in with Alex and gives her some news that could lead to civil war within the Black Ink Crew. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew The Year of the Puma
programme.desc: When Dutchess tells Ceaser the news about Puma's new tattoo shop, he is shocked and hurt by his friend's betrayal. Ceaser tattoos Jadakiss, who gets him thinking about friendship and loyalty. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew You're a Wreck!
programme.desc: AIDS activist Maria Davis visits Dutchess at the shop for an HIV/AIDS Awareness tattoo and the entire crew is moved by her inner strength and personal story. After arriving over 4 hours late, Alex makes a dramatic exit from a photo shoot. Presented by VH1

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew I Did Not Sleep With That Women!
programme.desc: When Dutchess and Ceaser are hours late for a photo shoot at the shop, the editor of the magazine rips them a new one. When Ceaser confronts Walt about his drinking, Walt reveals some shocking news that will change his future. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: O'S**t reaches new "baby mama" heights when he reveals that he has yet another child on the way. Dutchess shows up at a meeting and sees an ex-boyfriend. When Ceaser finds out, he loses his cool and deserts her at his family BBQ. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Have Several Seats
programme.desc: In the wake of Dutchess and Ceaser's fight, Ceaser is left confused about their future together and escapes to Puma's bachelor party in Atlantic City. Kathy comes for a tattoo from O'S**t, to get some closure and move on with her life. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew You Got Some Stupid Ears
programme.desc: Puma decides to invite Ceaser to his wedding on the condition that he leaves Dutchess at home. Walt's frustrating search comes to an end when a letter arrives at the shop with information about his father. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Tell the Truth and Shame the Devil
programme.desc: O'S**t's baby mamas, Coley and Kathy, face each other for the first time since their violent "family meal." Ceaser is torn between his friends and his woman as Dutchess reacts negatively to not being invited to Puma's wedding. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When O'S**t reappears at the shop, Walt tears into him about friendship and responsibility. After fighting in Jamaica together, Dutchess runs from the resort and, unbeknownst to Ceaser, ends up collapsing in the parking lot. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew From Wedlock to Headlock
programme.desc: The crew are having the time of their lives in Jamaica but are shocked when Ceaser suddenly sends Dutchess packing! At the wedding, the crew is left wondering if this Black Ink love story will have an unhappy ending. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Das wahre Zuhause - Steffen Frahm, ein alter Freund von Kathrin Globisch, muss sich einer Bypass-OP unterziehen. Er hofft auf eine neue Liebe mit Kathrin, doch er spürt, dass in ihrem Leben kein Platz für ihn ist. Alexander Weber ist überraschend wieder in Leipzig und versteckt sich bei Kathrin. Er bittet sie, zusammen mit ihm nach Kuba zu gehen und dort ein neues Leben zu beginnen. Als Philipp sich über die neuesten sportlichen Pläne von Hans-Peter lustig macht, wird er von Arzu unsanft darauf hingewiesen, dass auch er mal etwas für seine Gesundheit tun könnte. In seiner Eitelkeit gekränkt, übertreibt er es gleich etwas mit dem Training und muss sich Hans-Peter gegenüber geschlagen geben.

programme.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?
programme.desc: Wer weiß denn sowas? - Schauspieler und Musiker Wotan Wilke Möhring ist ab Staffel 12 neuer Teamkapitän bei "Wer weiß denn sowas?". Zusammen mit Bernhard Hoëcker stellt er sich den unglaublichen, amüsanten und überraschenden Fragen von Moderator Kai Pflaume. Superhirn Bernhard Hoëcker und Quizmaster Wotan Wilke Möhring spielen im Team mit jeweils einem prominenten Studiogast, denn es gilt, richtige Antworten auf skurrile und knifflige Fragen aus Wissenschaft, Tierwelt und dem täglichen Leben zu finden. (Erstsendung im Ersten: 27.01.2026)

programme.title: Quizduell-Olymp
programme.desc: Quizduell - Olymp - In der Quizshow tritt ein prominentes Rateteam gegen drei erfahrene Quiz-Profis an, die gemeinsam den sogenannten Olymp bilden. In mehreren Fragerunden müssen die Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten ihr Wissen aus unterschiedlichsten Themengebieten unter Beweis stellen. Das Spiel gliedert sich in eine Hauptrunde und ein spannendes Finale, in dem die Entscheidung über Sieg oder Niederlage fällt. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Wissen und Schnelligkeit, sondern auch um die Chance auf die Gewinnsumme von 10.000 Euro. Die Sendung verbindet Unterhaltung, Spannung und Wissensvermittlung zu einem abwechslungsreichen Quizerlebnis.

programme.title: Stationen
programme.desc: Michi Schreiber ist erfolgreiche Buchautorin und Affenforscherin. Die 29-Jährige hat ihren Abschluss als Primatologin an der renommierten Oxford Universität gemacht und sich ganz der Arbeit mit Affen in Südafrika verschrieben. Alles wirkt wie eine Bilderbuchgeschichte, bis Michi Schreiber bei einem schweren Autounfall 2025 ihr Gedächtnis verliert. Jetzt lebt sie wieder in der Eifel und kämpft dafür, nach Afrika zu ihren geliebten Affen zurückzukehren. Nur Wochen vor ihrem Unfall war Michi Schreiber kurz davor, in Südafrika eine Auffangstation für Affen zu gründen, die verletzt oder im illegalen Tierhandel beschlagnahmt wurden.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert neue Kämpfer wollen die Burg erstürmen und den General stolz machen. Doch wer kann das Bowlingspiel, die Rutschwand und die Hängebrücke überwinden?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert mutige Kandidaten treten an, um Takeshis Burg zu stürmen. Zuerst müssen sie aber Wasser, Schlamm und viele andere unschöne Dinge überwinden. Nur die Stärksten können es schaffen.

programme.desc: Stimpleton versucht Renwaldo vor dem Verhungern zu retten. // Haggis McHaggis muss Tests von einem Kobold bestehen, um sich seinen Traum zu erfüllen: einen Kopf voll mit Haaren.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Ein Herz und ein Geflügel / Pulvertoastmann gegen Waffelweib
programme.sub-title: Ein Herz und ein Geflügel / Pulvertoastmann gegen Waffelweib
programme.desc: Stimpy verliebt sich in ein im Laden gekauftes Huhn. // Powdered Toastman kämpft gegen seine Erzfeindin Waffle Woman.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Ein Hundeleben / Eidottrio
programme.desc: Ren und Stimpy werden von einer reichen alten Dame vor der Gaskammer des Hundezwingers gerettet. // Renwaldo, der Eiermann, erschafft aus Eidotter seinen eigenen Sohn und wünscht sich, dass er ein echter Junge wird...

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Schnarchen mit Stimpy / Mein Freund, die Glotze
programme.sub-title: Schnarchen mit Stimpy / Mein Freund, die Glotze
programme.desc: Ren kann nicht schlafen, und sein Freund Stimpy versucht ihm zu helfen. // Stimpys TV-Gewohnheiten geraten außer Kontrolle. Er hängt den ganzen Tag vor der Glotze, während Ren hart arbeitet.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Käserausch / Würstchenbarone
programme.desc: Ren & Stimpy machen sich zu den Blaukäsebergen auf, um dort als Bergarbeiter zu arbeiten. // Ren und Stimpy befinden sich auf dem Arbeitsamt und müssen erkennen, dass sie für jeden Job völlig unterqualifiziert sind.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Klopsboys / Ren braucht Hilfe
programme.desc: Heute geht es in den Wilden Westen: Am Lagerfeuer erzählt Wilbur Cobb eine Geschichte über die Klopsboys, zwei tölpelhafte Cowboys. //Durch Stimpy hat Ren all seine Habseligkeiten verloren.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Ol Blue Nose / Aufstand der Prügelknaben
programme.sub-title: Ol Blue Nose / Aufstand der Prügelknaben

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Das verflixte neunte Leben / Pater Jack Cheese
programme.sub-title: Das verflixte neunte Leben / Pater Jack Cheese
programme.desc: Stimpy verbrät sieben seiner Leben und geht alles Weitere mit mehr Vorsicht an. // Ren und Stimpy haben einen neuen Job: Sie arbeiten für Pater Jack Cheese, der eine eigenwillige frohe Botschaft verkündet.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Wettlauf im All / Die Fehde
programme.desc: Ren und Stimpy sollen als erster Hund und als erste Katze ins All geschossen werden. // Ren und Stimpy erzählen die Geschichte von den beiden Cowboys Schwachkopf und Dummkopf, die sich gegenseitig nicht leiden können...

programme.title: Nathan For You
programme.desc: Nathan hilft einem Spirituosenladen dabei, Alkohol an minderjährige Kunden zu verkaufen. Ein Kammerjäger lernt in einem Hotel bei seiner Arbeit unerkannt zu bleiben.

programme.title: Nathan For You
programme.desc: Nathan nutzt die Satirefreiheit, um einem Café in Schwierigkeiten zu helfen.

programme.title: Nathan For You
programme.desc: Nathan tritt gegen einen großen Konzern an, um einem in Schwierigkeiten geratenen Elektronikgeschäft zu helfen.

programme.title: Nathan For You
programme.desc: Nathan versucht, einen Werbevertrag mit einem Nachwuchstalentfür ein Sportgeschäft zu sichern. Eine Antiquitätenhändlerin lernt ihr Prinzip zu optimieren, dass Kunden das, was sie beschädigen, auch kaufen müssen.

programme.title: Awkwafina is Nora from Queens: Albträume
programme.desc: Nora hat Albträume, weiß nicht, warum und hat Angst, es ihrer Familie zu sagen. Wally wird gefeuert, kurz bevor er Brenda einen Antrag machen will. Ein Bekannter von Oma stirbt, und sie fühlt sich alt. Edmund hat Erfolg als Schauspieler.

programme.title: Awkwafina is Nora from Queens: Die Spielshow
programme.desc: Nora nimmt an einer neuen Spielshow teil, um ihrem Vater zu zeigen, dass sie sich konzentrieren und Sachen zu Ende bringen kann. Wally ist mehr zu Hause, und mischt sich in Omas Leben ein: Er wird überfürsorglich, wenn es um ihren Tritthocker geht.

programme.title: Awkwafina is Nora from Queens: Liebe & Ordnung
programme.desc: Durch ein Selbsthilfebuch lernt Nora, dass sie am glücklichsten ist, wenn sie andere unterstützt. Wally kriegt einen Job als Sam-Ash-Verkäufer, erzählt Brenda aber nichts davon. Edmund erfährt durch einen DNA-Test, dass er zum Teil isländisch ist.

programme.title: Awkwafina is Nora from Queens: þetta reddast
programme.desc: Nora und Edmund reisen nach Island. Nora trifft eine Elfe, die ihr einen Kristall schenkt und ihr den Satz ;þetta reddast; beibringt. Oma sieht nach Nora und Edmund. Edmund stellt später fest, dass eine Affäre seine DNA-Testergebnisse verfälscht hat.

programme.title: Awkwafina is Nora from Queens: Oma verkauft Gras
programme.desc: Wally beichtet Brenda von seinem neuen Job, was schlecht rüberkommt. Oma findet eine Hanfpflanze und gründet ein Grasimperium in Queens. Sie genießt die Macht, merkt aber, dass sie das alles gar nicht braucht. Sie will nur für ihre Familie da sein.

programme.title: Awkwafina is Nora from Queens: Traumauto
programme.desc: Nora fährt in den Norden, um Mandy zu kaufen, und wird beraubt. Durch ihren isländischen Kristall besucht sie andere Versionen ihres Lebens und trifft...Awkwafina? Wally will Brenda zurückgewinnen, doch er scheitert. Er braucht etwas Zeit für sich.

programme.title: Awkwafina is Nora from Queens: Awkwafina & Teresa Hsiao
programme.desc: Nora trifft Awkwafina, die ihr eine neue Sicht gibt. Sie kauft die Bodega von Mr. Moon und will in Queens bleiben. Wally und Brenda heiraten! Oma ist glücklich, weil ihre Familie es ist. Edmund findet bei der Hochzeit Liebe: Ist er der Richtige?

programme.title: Drawn Together: Whirlpool
programme.desc: Die Bewohner treffen sich zum ersten Mal im Haus. Prinzessin Clara beleidigt Foxxy, indem sie sie als Dienstmädchen anspricht. Toot will mit Xandir anbandeln, aber er befindet sich bereits auf einer Mission seine Freundin zu retten.

programme.title: Drawn Together: Claras schmutziges Geheimnis
programme.desc: Eine mögliche Schwangerschaft ist Claras kleinste Sorge, als der Rest des Hauses von ihrem kleinen 'privaten Problem' erfährt. Scheinbar hat ihre böse Stiefmutter sie mit einem Fluch belegt und jetzt wohnt ein bizarres Tentakelmonster in ihrer Vagina

programme.title: Behind CXMT IPO and China’s chip roadmap
programme.desc: As CXMT makes its market debut on Shanghai's STAR Market, the listing is drawing attention far beyond the trading floor. What does the IPO mean for investors, the capital market, and the future of the global memory-chip industry? Join us on BizTalk as we explore market forces, policy priorities and the roadmap to technology self-reliance behind the landmark listing.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: 2026 WORLD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CONFERENCE SPECIAL | China’s Vision for AI Development and Global Governance
programme.desc: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) will conclude on 20th July in Shanghai. Join CGTN Biztalk on July 20 as it invites conference participants, industry observers and researchers to discuss the outcomes of the conference, and look into how China leverages WAIC as a premier industrial platform to foster dialogue, bridge divides, and promote shared governance.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc: Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy. We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations. One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays. At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward. In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future. Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Cheers: Sams künftige Ex-Frau
programme.desc: Sam hat sich entschlossen, zusammen mit Coach seinen High-School-Abschluss nachzumachen. Er hat überraschend gute Noten. Diane merkt als erste, dass er sie vor allem für außerschulische Leistungen mit der attraktiven Lehrerin bekommt.

programme.title: Cheers: Mit fremden Federn
programme.desc: Cliff ist krank. Gerne nimmt er Norms Angebot an, die Post für ihn zuzustellen. Leider wird der Aushilfsbriefträger von der Polizei geschnappt. Die beschuldigt ihn, die Briefe gestohlen und das Postgeheimnis gebrochen zu haben.

programme.title: Cheers: Carla und ihr Affe
programme.desc: Sam wird mit einer Wette konfrontiert, an die er sich nicht mehr ganz erinnern kann: Vor einem Jahr hatte er gewettet, dass er die Schauspielerin Jacqueline Bisset heiraten werde – sonst würde sein Wettpartner Eddie das Cheers bekommen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Rausschmeißer vom Dienst
programme.desc: Mädchen und Männersport – so lauten Sams Hauptinteressen. Doch als er die attraktive Reporterin Paula kennen lernt, will er dieser imponieren: Plötzlich brilliert Sam mit gebildeten Kommentaren zu Kunst und Kultur.

programme.title: Cheers: Anfang oder Ende?
programme.desc: Nick, Carlas Ex-Ehemann, kommt eines Abends völlig fertig ins Cheers: sein blondes Dummchen Loretta hat ihn sitzen gelassen. Nun steht er ohne einen Cent da. Sam gibt ihm einen Putzjob im Cheers.

programme.title: Cheers: Mamis Leidenschaft
programme.desc: Norm hat einen neuen Job bekommen: Er soll in seiner Firma überflüssig gewordenen Kollegen eröffnen, dass die Geschäftsleitung sie entlassen wird.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine Flamme in Florida
programme.desc: Dianes neuer Freund Frasier soll für ein halbes Jahr als Gastdozent nach Bologna. Diane ist begeistert: Frasier will, dass sie ihn begleitet. Dann fällt ihr Sam ein. Trotz der offiziellen Trennung spukt er Diane immer noch im Kopf herum.

programme.title: Cheers: Nachtflug nach Florenz
programme.desc: Sam hat eine neue Kellnerin eingestellt. Sie ist nicht mehr jung, aber dafür eine absolute Perle. Die Gäste sind begeistert. Da kommt ihre hübsche Tochter zu Besuch. Sam ist verrückt nach ihr. Carla verbietet Sam, etwas mit ihr anzufangen.

programme.title: Cheers: Wenn der Reisprüfer kommt...
programme.desc: Sam hat Diane in Italien aus den Augen verloren. Er wollte dort ihre Heirat verhindern. Nun kommt er deprimiert nach Hause. So geht es auch Frasier. Ihm ist Diane vor dem Traualtar davongelaufen. Sam sucht nach Diane. Er findet sie in einem Kloster.

programme.title: Cheers: Woodys Appetit
programme.desc: Woody Boyd, der neue Barkeeper und Nachfolger des verstorbenen Coach, ist dauernd allein. Da beschließen die Stammgäste im Cheers, seine Freundin Beth einzufliegen. Kaum sind die beiden zusammen, fangen sie an zu futtern wie Scheunendrescher.

programme.title: Cheers: Märchenprinz im Kaschmirmantel
programme.desc: Ein wertvoller Kaschmirmantel ist im Cheers liegengeblieben. Das Fundstück animiert Dianes Phantasie: In so einem Mantel muss ein toller Kerl stecken! Kurze Zeit später meldet sich der Mantelbesitzer.

programme.title: Cheers: Das ist die Liebe der Tortellis
programme.sub-title: Das ist die Liebe der Tortellis
programme.desc: Carlas 16-jähriger Sohn Anthony will seine Freundin unbedingt heiraten. Sämtliche Überredungskünste seiner Mutter bleiben erfolglos. Schließlich gibt sie ihre Einwilligung.

programme.title: Cheers: Alptraum im Alptraum
programme.desc: Diane büffelt bis tief in die Nacht für ihr Examen. Dabei nickt sie in Sams Büro ein. Plötzlich ein Schrei: Diane hat geträumt, der geisteskranke Andy, der sie einst umbringen wollte, sei wieder frei.

programme.title: Cheers: Der wahre Wert der Literatur
programme.desc: Diane leiht sich 500 Dollar von Sam. Sie will eine wertvolle Hemingway-Erstausgabe kaufen. Bis sie das Geld zurück zahlen kann, soll Sam das Buch in seinem Safe aufbewahren. Der tollpatschige Sam liest in dem Buch – und macht es kaputt.

programme.title: Cheers: Carlas Traummann
programme.desc: Carla hat eine Kontaktanzeige aufgegeben. Ihre Freunde im Cheers antworten auf die Anzeige im Namen eines unbekannten Traummannes. Carla verliebt sich in ihn schon auf dem Papier.

programme.title: Cheers: Liebe deinen Nachbarn...
programme.desc: Norm und seine Ehefrau sind endlich mal ausgegangen. Sie waren mit den Nachbarn tanzen. Das war so nett, dass die Nachbarsfrau glaubt, ihr Mann hätte ein Verhältnis mit Vera. Sie kann Norm überzeugen, dass ein Privatdetektiv die beiden überwachen soll.

programme.title: Cheers: Rivalen der Bowlingbahn
programme.desc: Das Team vom Cheers hat gegen eine andere Kneipe ein Baseballspiel verloren. Der Besitzer der Konkurrenzbar bietet Revanche in einer beliebigen Sportart nach Wahl an.

programme.title: Cheers: Der verlorene Vater
programme.desc: Sam hat wieder einmal eine neue Flamme, Claudia. Sie ist hübsch, witzig und gebildet. Auch Diane freundet sich mit ihr an. Claudia überredet Sam, Diane mit zum Essen zu nehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Don Juans Vorlesung
programme.desc: Diane soll für die Uni eine Arbeit zum Thema ,,Menschliche Sexualität" schreiben. Dafür nimmt sie sich Sam als Beispiel. Aus ihrer eigenen Erfahrung entsteht eine Fallstudie über einen notorischen Aufreißer und Don Juan. Sam ist davon begeistert.

programme.title: Cheers: Woodys Wette
programme.desc: Sam verspricht Barkeeper Woody, für ihn eine 1000 Dollar-Wette beim Buchmacher zu plazieren. Tatsächlich bringt die Wette 10.000 Dollar Gewinn ein. Das Peinliche ist nur: Sam hat gar nicht erst gesetzt.

programme.title: Cheers: Das letzte Hemd
programme.desc: Im Fernsehen werden gebrauchte Sachen von Prominenten für einen guten Zweck versteigert. Sam steuert sein Baseballtrikot der Boston Red Sox bei. Er ist sicher, dass es weggehen wird wie die warmen Semmeln. Doch das Ding erweist sich als Ladenhüter.

programme.title: Cheers: Kleine Streiche erhalten die Freundschaft
programme.desc: Im Cheers treibt sich seit einiger Zeit ein mysteriöser Mann herum: Er sitzt den ganzen Tag nur da und beobachtet die Leute. Langam werden alle unruhig. Ist der Fremde gar ein Spitzel?

programme.title: Cheers: Das Dreieck der Beklagenswerten
programme.desc: Dianes Ex-Verlobter Frasier verkommt immer mehr. Um ihm zu helfen, denken sich Sam und Diane etwas aus: Sam soll Frasier vorspielen, er leide unter Depressionen. So kann Frasier sein Selbstvertrauen als Seelenarzt wiedererlangen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Postbotenball
programme.desc: Cliff Postbote des Jahres. Beim großen Postbotenball soll er seine Auszechnung erhalten. Dazu braucht er eine passende weibliche Begleitung. In seiner Verzweiflung überredet er Clara. Die lässt sich den kleinen Gefallen aber einiges kosten.

programme.title: Cheers: Was Süßes für Frasier!
programme.desc: Frasier kann bei den Frauen einfach nicht landen. Sam und seine Stammgäste werden wieder einmal Zeuge einer derben Abfuhr für den Armen. Sie beschließen, ihm zu helfen. Eine Ehemalige von Sam wird ins Cheers bestellt und mit Frasier bekanntgemacht.

programme.title: Cheers: Mit der Frau vom Chef
programme.desc: Norm soll befördert werden. Für den Posten gibt es einen weiteren Anwärter. Dieser hat allerdings ein Verhältnis mit der Frau vom Chef. Norm überlegt, dieses Wissen für sich zu nutzen. Aber die Cheers-Mannschaft appelliert an seine Anständigkeit.

programme.title: Cheers: Sam Malone wird niemals alt!
programme.desc: Sams Freundinnen werden immer jünger. Er will damit allen beweisen, wie fitt er noch ist. Deshalb geht er auch mit Woody zum Sport. Dabei verletzt er sich. Heimlich begibt er sich in ein Krankenhaus. Dort baggert er pausenlos die Schwestern an.

programme.title: Cheers: Der letzte Tango
programme.desc: Carla ist aufgeregt: Die Showtruppe, bei der sie früher mit Nick getanzt hat, veranstaltet ein Tanzturnier. Alle ehemaligen Mitglieder sind eingeladen. Den Siegern winken 500 Dollar und eine Reise nach Hawaii. Nick ist bereit, mit ihr dorthin zu gehen.

programme.title: Cheers: Geständnisse im Cockpit
programme.desc: Jack, ein alter Verehrer von Diane, taucht im Cheers auf. Diane hatte ihn in Europa kennengelernt, nachdem die Affäre mit Frasier beendet war. Nun ist Jack enttäuscht: Er findet, Diane sei langweilig und fade geworden.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: Exploring Ethnic Attire: Dong Elegance
programme.desc: Dong clothing weaves together tradition, craftsmanship, and the unique identity of the Dong ethnic group. In this episode, we’ll unravel the stories behind the intricate designs, vibrant colors, and deep cultural significance of Dong attire. From ceremonial garments to everyday wear, each piece is imbued with the essence of a rich heritage.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the “La’aomen” harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: “Mountain Orchid Rice”.

programme.title: A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade
programme.desc: The documentary "A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade" follows a father and son as they carry forward the centuries-old craft of making Luzhou oil-paper umbrellas. Each umbrella tells a story—not only of skill, but of family and cultural resilience. As part of CGTN’s original series "Next Stop: China," this episode journeys into the lush bamboo forests of Sichuan, where traditional craftsmanship finds new life in the modern world.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.7
programme.desc: Jiangsu---an aquatic lowland stitched together by the Yangtze and Grand Canal. From Yellow Sea wetlands populated by red-crowned cranes to the Yangtze estuary's port history, this is a land and coast where maritime legends are made!

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.7
programme.desc: Jiangsu---an aquatic lowland stitched together by the Yangtze and Grand Canal. From Yellow Sea wetlands populated by red-crowned cranes to the Yangtze estuary's port history, this is a land and coast where maritime legends are made!

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade
programme.desc: The documentary "A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade" follows a father and son as they carry forward the centuries-old craft of making Luzhou oil-paper umbrellas. Each umbrella tells a story—not only of skill, but of family and cultural resilience. As part of CGTN’s original series "Next Stop: China," this episode journeys into the lush bamboo forests of Sichuan, where traditional craftsmanship finds new life in the modern world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Crossroads of Cultures: The Legacy of Silk Roads
programme.desc: Quanzhou, situated on the southeastern coast of China, once served as a maritime hub of the East and Southeast Asia trade network during the 10th to 14th centuries, gaining prominence for its exceptional trading port. With 22 distinctive heritage sites listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, this city stands as a testament to the legendary history of the Silk Roads. In this program, we invite four individuals living in Quanzhou to showcase their daily lives, capturing their journeys through the city's world heritage sites. Through their perspectives, we present a dynamic portrayal of a city rich in heritage. From the maritime splendor of Quanzhou's history to the serene echoes of its ancient city, from the historical treasures of the Luoyang Bridge to the vibrancy of the modern urban landscape, we journey alongside our guests through time and space, exploring Quanzhou's diverse charm and unique allure. Join us as we immerse ourselves in a city that bridges history and cultures, and embraces innovation.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. As the city with the most land ports in Xizang, Shigatse serves as a key corridor to South Asia. Here, Tianran samples breakfast at a bustling local teahouse and experiences monastic life at the vast Tashilunpo Monastery. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: Shared Roots in Wrestling
programme.desc: The documentary “Shared Roots in Wrestling” follows a young wrestler from Tianjin as he journeys to Inner Mongolia to explore the shared heritage of Chinese-style wrestling and Bökh, the region’s national wrestling tradition. Part of CGTN’s original series “Next Stop: China,” this episode uncovers how strength, skill, and resilience connect athletes across city streets and endless grasslands, carrying forward a legacy that transcends geography and generations.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: Suqian
programme.desc: Suqian is a small city in Jiangsu Province, which may not be so famous nowadays. In history, there was a famous figure here: Xiang Yu! Suqian is of great significance to our presenter Megan. Although she grew up in the United States, Suqian is her hometown. This time, let's follow the presenter to have a look at the local customs of her hometown that she always misses.
